t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Be consistent, there may be a pattern dealing with time taken between button clicks.

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to which mushroom person gives you more mushrooms. It stays pretty consistent to each pair through the whole game. The better answer shouldn't give you 0 at any point. In my case it was pink over green, purple over brown,blue over green, red over yellow, but it may be different in your game. Use the x1 modifier as your time to experiment.  A good average would be about 1100 points per round.
